beats.headline: First out of the first box
beats.text: The first of Carl's ten boxes is bronze, with a strange, hedgehog-like animal stencilled on the top: Bronze Pet Box. It pops open on its own and disappears in a puff of smoke, leaving a single rolled-up piece of paper and a small pile of what looks like dry cat food. Text appears over each: Scroll of Heal Critter. Pet Biscuit X 10. The items go into his inventory, and before he can open it to read the scroll's description, the next box appears.

beats.headline: No valid target
beats.text: The cat is soaked in blood, but alive. Carl worriedly watches her health, waits ten frustrating seconds for the Winner! graphic to clear, and finds what he is looking for in his inventory: a scroll of Heal Critter. He reads it, but it doesn't work on her, and it evaporates from his menu with an error message. No Valid Target Available. You just wasted a valuable scroll, dumbass. He can't cast his heal spell on her either, so he pulls a healing potion instead.

beats.headline: Another off a kobold
beats.text: Carl had no Heal Critter scrolls left in the cage room, where the beaten dingoes got pet biscuits instead. Now the dingoes are gone, and he picks through the slagged, smoldering remains of the kobolds in the main room, looting a few spiked helmets and gold coins here and there. One of them has a scroll of Heal Critter and a handful of pet biscuits.

beats.headline: It fizzles
beats.text: The monster blocks magic, Carl tells Mordecai, and Mordecai answers that it likely means no spells, no scrolls. Mongo rushes into the kitchen screaming, bleeding from dozens of places where the other two clockwork Mongos exploded. Donut's heal spell has stopped working. She rushes to him, his health about halfway down, and glows as she tries a Heal Critter scroll. The spell fizzles out. His health is going back up on its own, Carl tells her; stop wasting scrolls, they won't work. Do you want some lemonade, Bonnie asks again.

relations.note: it does not work on her
